notes.title: 06/01/2015 Patch Notes
notes.content:
DK2 support enabled, however head tracking is disabled due to the large field of the game.
Refined configuration for pads/joysticks/keyboard.

Upcoming:
Separate sensitivity per input device.
Multiplayer support.
